en.dead_delivery_hint: DEAD — new purchases are delivered after respawn
en.forge_queued: {item} for {hero} will be delivered after respawn!
en.howto_goal_1: Destroy the Dire Nexus (castle) before the Radiant Nexus falls.
en.howto_goal_2: Winning pays meta gold that unlocks heroes in the HERO SHOP.
en.howto_hard_1: Hard: enemies +15% HP, +10% damage, the Dire castle starts higher.
en.howto_hard_2: Gold income is smaller (x0.75). Easy: x1.25.
en.howto_heroes_1: You start without heroes. Open H → HERO to buy one you already unlocked.
en.howto_heroes_2: Up to 5 unique heroes. A dead hero respawns after 10 seconds keeping its level and items.
en.howto_heroes_3: Click a Radiant hero to select it, then Q/W/E/R for skills (R = ultimate).
en.howto_heroes_4: Heroes you do not select fight on their own (auto-cast).
en.howto_progress_1: First win: 3000 meta gold. A winning replay: 1500 (once), then 200.
en.howto_progress_2: A boss defeated plus its castle fallen unlocks that hero for FREE.
en.howto_progress_3: ENTER after a win moves on to the next level (new theme & boss).
en.howto_shop_1: 4 tabs: TOWERS / ITEMS / HERO / NEXUS. Items use 6 slots per hero.
en.howto_shop_2: Upgrading the nexus raises its HP and your team's minion scale.
en.howto_towers_1: Click an empty slot circle (+) on a lane and build a tower (100 gold).
en.howto_towers_2: 4 paths: Archer / Cannon / Ice / Mage. The Lv1→Lv2 upgrade picks the path.
en.howto_waves_1: The first wave arrives after 5 seconds. Minions trickle out on all three lanes.
en.howto_waves_2: The next wave waits 25 seconds and for every minion of the old wave to fall.
